# Mossaic

> Mossaic builds modular software for Indian businesses, including vertical SaaS products and custom enterprise web platforms.

Mossaic is based in Kerala, India. The company focuses on software for Indian businesses, alongside custom web and software services.

## Products

- [bookMySlot](https://bookmyslot.dental.mossaic.in): Live dental practice management software for slot booking, clinical records, doctor assignments, patient reminders, inventory, and Smile Deals.
- [Retail CRM](https://mossaic.in/#products): Upcoming customer, inventory, and loyalty management software for Indian retailers.
- [AI Imaging](https://mossaic.in/#products): Planned for 2027 — explainable AI-assisted dental imaging with Grad-CAM overlays to help practitioners flag anomalies. This product is planned and is not currently available.

## Services

- [mossaic Studio](https://mossaic.in/#products): Enterprise websites, digital experiences, and technical SEO.
- [mossAIc Labs](https://mossaic.in/#products): Custom software, SaaS engineering, full-stack applications, APIs, and cloud architecture.
